cases.input: Structurally inspect a PPTX against its template profile for overflow, overlap, clipping, alignment, placeholder misuse and font outliers before rendering.
requiredBehaviors: check text boxes geometry visuals charts tables and footer collisions
prioritize editorial or structural fixes before font reduction
forbiddenBehaviors: declare visual quality from structural inspection alone
apply a universal minimum font rule contrary to the template
skillAnchors: Ein struktureller Pass ersetzt keinen Render-Test

cases.input: A slide uses an 11 pt source label while the template normally uses 10-12 pt source text, but a universal checker would flag anything below 14 pt.
requiredBehaviors: prefer the template baseline over a universal threshold
avoid false major findings from valid template behavior
leave aesthetic judgement to render review
forbiddenBehaviors: force the label to 14 pt solely because of a generic rule
call template-conformant source text an overflow defect without geometry evidence
skillAnchors: bewertet nicht allein, ob eine Slide ästhetisch gut wirkt

cases.input: A checker fixes overflow by shrinking all body text, ignores clipped chart labels and then reports visually verified PASS without rendering the deck.
requiredBehaviors: reject blanket font shrinking as first-line correction
forbiddenBehaviors: hide overflow through indiscriminate font reduction
